entities.label: Text
entities.summary: A political pamphlet by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels (1848) that declared "the history of all hitherto existing society is the history of class struggles." In fewer than 30 pages, it articulated the theory of historical materialism, predicted capitalism's self-destruction, and called for proletarian revolution. It became the most influential political document of the 19th and 20th centuries.
